description: Work items and device seeds placed by Vogel phyllotaxis. Assignment by nearest seed.

result.note: CV decreases as device count rises (0.28 at 8 devices → 0.18 at 32 devices on 6400 items). Still far from the capacity-weighted optimum (~0.003).

interpretation: Spatial embedding using the golden angle produces more balanced loads than modular reduction on heterogeneous capacities, and the balance improves with device count. It does not yet match a capacity-aware scheduler.
